As Emerson Elec Co (EMR) Shares Declined, Shareholder Forbes J M & Co Llp Has Upped Its Position; Raymond James Trust Holding in Hershey Foods Co (HSY) Increased by $3.05 Million
May 21, 2018 - By Darrin Black
Forbes J M & Co Llp increased its stake in Emerson Elec Co (EMR) by 508.69% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Forbes J M & Co Llp bought 65,952 shares as the company’s stock declined 2.50% with the market. The institutional investor held 78,917 shares of the consumer electronics and appliances company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $5.50M, up from 12,965 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Forbes J M & Co Llp who had been investing in Emerson Elec Co for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $46.68B market cap company. The stock increased 1.29% or $0.94 during the last trading session, reaching $74.08. About 2.22 million shares traded. Emerson Electric Co. (NYSE:EMR) has risen 16.24% since May 21, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 4.69% the S&P500.
Raymond James Trust increased its stake in Hershey Foods Co (HSY) by 616.05% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Raymond James Trust bought 27,020 shares as the company’s stock declined 14.93% with the market. The institutional investor held 31,406 shares of the specialty foods company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $3.57 million, up from 4,386 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Raymond James Trust who had been investing in Hershey Foods Co for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $19.27 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.62% or $0.57 during the last trading session, reaching $92.06. About 1.02M shares traded. The Hershey Company (NYSE:HSY) has declined 9.67% since May 21, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 21.22% the S&P500.
